repaired_failures.name: CALLER_SUPPLIED_POLICY_CAN_LAUNDER_HELDOUT
repaired_failures.repair: Protected export now accepts only policies authenticated by a compile-time-pinned registry; arbitrary caller-built policy objects cannot become authority.

repaired_failures.name: OFF_REPO_POLICY_PATH_ACCEPTED_AS_ROOT
repaired_failures.repair: Policy paths must exactly match registry-listed canonical repository paths and Git blob identities; off-repository policy files fail closed.

repaired_failures.name: CROSS_SUITE_CASE_ID_COLLISION_NOT_REJECTED
repaired_failures.repair: Policy construction and authenticated-policy validation reject duplicate benchmark case_id values across trusted suites.

repaired_failures.name: SUITE_BLOB_REPLAY_ALTERNATE_FAMILY_ROOT
repaired_failures.repair: The authenticated policy blob binds suite path, suite blob, family root, manifest path/blob, and source case identities; replay policies at alternate roots are not registered authority.

additional_guards: ordinary source Git blobs may not equal benchmark source-case blobs inside an authenticated policy
the registry file itself is pinned by Git blob SHA-1 in the exporter
legacy v0.3.1 policy remains registry-authenticated for exposed regression compatibility
next_required_evidence: Freeze v0.4.1 and create a genuinely new post-freeze policy-root suite; v0.4 remains exposed forever.
